name: BelugaDex liability/coverage withdrawal accounting
summary: The pool applied inconsistent liability and equilibrium-coverage accounting across deposits, swaps, and withdrawals, allowing a repeated 21-transaction campaign to deplete its USDT and USDC.e custody assets.

loss.notes: Gross loss is the exact net ERC-20 outflow across all 21 successful campaign receipts from Beluga's USDT custody contract 0xcff307451e52b7385a7538f4cf4a861c7a60192b and USDC.e custody contract 0x7cc32ee9567b48182e5424a2a782b2aa6cd0b37b. Netting transfers into the same custody contracts excludes campaign financing and returns 65,348.918901 USDT plus 115,368.655450 USDC.e. Both components are valued at par at the incident anchor; later exchange proceeds, fees, gas, and recovery are outside this gross victim-depletion boundary.

ageReset.description: The only pre-incident canonical Upgraded event on the proxy installed implementation 0x22d909abe10cc2f9fffa4770d8adca0a89493eb0. The implementation slot still selected it immediately before the incident, its 19,738-byte runtime hash was unchanged from activation, and every incident-trace call to the proxy delegated to it.

sources.note: Reviewed the successful transaction set, anchor call trace, custody-token logs, direct proxy creation receipt, full canonical upgrade-log history, EIP-1967 implementation slot, implementation runtime, verified Pool source, commit-pinned technical reproduction, and published technical analysis. The anchor is successful at block 140129167 index 1, timestamp 1697161745. Its trace reaches proxy 0x15a024061c151045ba483e9243291dee6ee5fd8a 280 times and each call delegates to 0x22d909abe10cc2f9fffa4770d8adca0a89493eb0. The verified Pool source and transaction behavior establish inconsistent liability and equilibrium-coverage handling across the affected accounting paths. The proxy was directly created at block 88448153 index 1 by 0xf6341e5f50483dcf9d5a65784d8d95a45868d89c in 0x457d7a44...5fd8, with code absent one block earlier. Its complete pre-incident canonical Upgraded log history contains one event: block 110661919 index 1, log index 1, transaction 0xf110ac55...09bf at timestamp 1689220880, installing 0x22d909abe10cc2f9fffa4770d8adca0a89493eb0. The EIP-1967 slot selects that address immediately before the incident, and its 19,738-byte runtime hashes to 0x22dc029f76d98981f3a35721797b5a0b28ac7162a6865592c171f5b13be521aa both at activation and before the incident. Code age is 1697161745 - 1689220880 = 7,940,865 seconds. Campaign scope is the 21 successful calls from 0x4843e00ef4c9f9f6e6ae8d7b0a787f1c60050b01 to helper 0x9e8675365366559053f964be5838d5fca008722c, from the anchor through block 140136949 index 1 at timestamp 1697164230. Summing Transfer logs over those receipts gives net custody depletion of 65,348.918901 USDT and 115,368.655450 USDC.e, $180,717.574351 at par. This exact gross boundary supersedes the seed's rounded $175,000 estimate.

notes: Replaces the seed's rounded $175,000 loss with exact gross stablecoin custody depletion across the complete 21-transaction campaign.
